'''''Scent of Fear''''' was a starship used by [[Crutag]] and his crew. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Scent of Fear'' chased a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ship to the swamp planet [[Trinta]], where both ships landed.
